tests.name: Bone and all arterial files become interactive before deferred downloads complete
Loading indicators exist only in the expanded anatomy panel
Clicking pending anatomy shows inline Please wait and prioritises its geometry
Background insertion pauses throughout a held rotation gesture
Late arrivals preserve camera, selection and hidden veins; a newer selection cancels stale queued focus
Full DSA becomes available after all vascular geometry is ready, while brain remains deferred
DSA preparation and a selective MMA run work before brain geometry loads
A queued brain selection completes automatically when its requested mesh arrives
All 1,250 runtime meshes match this release reference positions, normals and triangle indices
Anatomy panel remains usable without horizontal overflow at mobile width
A failed background file can be retried inline without losing loaded anatomy or DSA

scope: All actual atlas geometry in Chromium with software WebGL, small rendering resolution. Interaction/background-arrival checks use the MMA preset, preserving hidden veins. Controlled delayed asset downloads. Frame times are diagnostics for this environment, not a mobile/GPU guarantee.
